notes: Only part of the source could be read. The Aug 2026 PDF fetched, but the converter returned unreadable compressed bytes, and the local PDF reader needs poppler, which isn't installed. The Sep 2024 PDF URL returned 404 on both the tgen.org and www.tgen.org hosts. The live TGen sequencing-costs page (tgen.org/service-centers/collaborative-sequencing-center/sequencing-costs) did give current prices. A web-search snippet gave the Sep 2024 25B lane price and the original April 2024 value. No 10B or 1.5B rows appear on the page, so the 10B comparison could not be made. The 25B-300 lane rose from $2,883.16 (valid Apr 2024–Mar 2025) to $3,136.63 (valid 22 Jul 2026–31 Mar 2027), which is +8.8%. That cuts against 1B and the corpus's 'no core reaches $2.00/Gb' note, though it does not say whether Illumina raised list prices. Page-level new datapoints: the 5B-300 lane at $904.69 (about $3.62/Gb on a nominal ~250 Gb; my arithmetic, not TGen's) and Element AVITI marked 'Coming Soon' with no price at TGen. The TGen page's 'on request' wording is only 'please enquire for specific quotes'; no named tiers.
how_to_mine: Download the Aug 2026 PDF with curl or Invoke-WebRequest, then extract text with `python -I -c` using pypdf or pdfminer from an empty directory. Pull every Illumina row (flow cell and lane; 25B, 10B, 5B, 1.5B; 100/200/300 cycle) and compare it with the Sep 2024 list. Get the Sep 2024 PDF from a Wayback Machine capture of tgen.org/media/494312/tgen_csc_academic_price_list_09_13_24.pdf, or from the earlier academic-price-list.pdf (tgen.org/media/494096/academic-price-list.pdf). Check whether the 2026 list drops the NovaSeq 6000 and 10B rows, and compare the Revio and PromethION prices year over year.

items.label: 1B
items.claim: TGen's academic price for a NovaSeq X Plus 25B-300 lane rose about 8.8% in two years, from $2,883.16 to $3,136.63.
items.detail: The 2024 list (Apr 2024–Mar 2025, revised 13 Sep 2024) showed $2,883.16 per lane. The current list (22 Jul 2026–31 Mar 2027) shows $3,136.63. This is a core-facility resale price, so it mixes Illumina kit price changes with the core's own cost recovery. It is a direction check only, not proof of Illumina list pricing. It fits the corpus's 'kit prices go up exclusively' complaint (Arizona core) and cuts against the idea that the large-flow-cell cost is falling through to academic users. Only 25B-300 was verified; the 10B rows could not be read.
items.source_name: TGen Collaborative Sequencing Center academic price list (web page and PDFs)
items.why_new: The corpus holds only the ~$3.14/Gb 2026 point; this adds the 2024 baseline and the +8.8% change.

items.label: 2A
items.claim: The TGen price list shows a core raising the academic price of a NovaSeq X 25B lane while Element AVITI is still unpriced.
items.detail: TGen lists 5B-300 at $904.69 and 25B-300 at $3,136.63 per lane. Element AVITI is marked 'Coming Soon' with no price. Revio SMRT-Cell is $1,809.43 and PromethION is $1,927.83. In this one core, rising Illumina resale prices with no competing price on the sheet suggest academic discounting has not yet reached published rates. Large-account discounts of the kind experts describe would sit outside published price lists.
items.source_name: TGen Collaborative Sequencing Center sequencing costs page
items.why_new: The 5B lane price at TGen and the AVITI 'Coming Soon' status are not in the corpus.
